rows.title: The Souvenir review – sumptuous class study puts Joanna Hogg in the limelight | The Souvenir
rows.dek_lead: The Souvenir is an artefact in the highest auteur register. Its absence of tonal readability is a challenge. But there is also a cerebrally fierce, slow-burn passion in its austere, unemphasised plainness.
